description: Convert any HTML or web page to clean, LLM-ready Markdown: a TypeScript library (Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, browsers), the webforai-cli CLI with an Agent Skill, and a hosted crawl/scrape API.
rules: Pass the page URL: htmlToMarkdown(html, { url }) resolves relative links and images and enables site adapters.
The library fetches nothing and uses no Node.js built-ins: in Cloudflare Workers, fetch the HTML yourself or use webforai/loaders/fetch; Playwright and Puppeteer loaders are Node-only.
Reader mode (default) returns the main content; presetExtractors("agent") adds a ## Links section an agent can follow, for about half the tokens of the whole page.
Use htmlToMarkdownWithMetadata, or frontmatter: true, to get the title, author and published date.
From a shell or a coding agent, use npx webforai-cli <url> (Markdown on stdout, --json for an envelope) rather than writing a script.
For JavaScript-rendered or bot-protected pages, use the hosted platform: npx webforai-cli <url> --engine auto with WEBFORAI_API_KEY, or GET https://platform.webforai.dev/<url>.
